files.title: File:Front Street, Marietta, OH (2023).jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Washington County Courthouse (Samuel Hannaford and Sons, 1902) visible in the background.  The buildings are contributing structures in the Marietta Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974, and expanded to its present size in 2001.

files.caption: Built in the 19th Century, these buildings are characteristic of the historic Downtown business district of the city of Marietta, Ohio.  The buildings are contributing structures in the Marietta Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974, and expanded to its present size in 2001.
